final_text:
Here are the top 3 customers by invoiced sales excluding tax from 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28.

**Source:** the released product DAILY_INVOICED_SALES, version 101, using the object `HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.L2P_RELEASE.DAILY_INVOICED_SALES_V0101`. The data is synthetic Northstar Supply data covering 2026-01-05 to 2026-03-03. Each row is one invoice date, customer and stock item, and the product's content hash matched when the ranking ran.

**Account-review shortlist, February 2026**

| Rank | Customer (ID) | Sales excluding tax | Invoice lines | Days with invoices | Different items | First / last invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fictional Customer 010 (10) | 3,275.27 | 10 | 4 | 9 | 2026-02-03 / 2026-02-22 |
| 2 | Fictional Customer 018 (18) | 2,787.78 | 14 | 5 | 10 | 2026-02-04 / 2026-02-26 |
| 3 | Fictional Customer 008 (8) | 2,600.14 | 10 | 4 | 8 | 2026-02-07 / 2026-02-20 |

"Sales excluding tax" is the invoice line price minus its tax amount, added up for the month. The product doesn't record a currency, so the amounts have none.

**What this data can't show:** the ranking is based only on invoiced sales. The product has no data on marketing consent, campaign response, margin or causal uplift. That means it can't tell you whether a campaign had any effect, whether these customers may be contacted, or whether they're profitable. Returns and discounts aren't included either, and days with no invoices aren't filled in as zero.
